title: Install Docker Desktop
body:
Testcontainers needs Docker from **week 4** (EF Core + Dapper integration tests).

```powershell
winget install -e --id Docker.DockerDesktop
```
Restart, open Docker Desktop once (it may ask to enable WSL 2), then:
```powershell
docker run --rm hello-world
```

## Done when
- [ ] `docker run --rm hello-world` prints *Hello from Docker!*
- [ ] Docker Desktop starts with Windows (Settings → General)

title: Install Node.js LTS and Angular CLI
body:
Week 8 (Build day) starts the Angular frontend.

```powershell
winget install -e --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS
# new terminal
npm install -g @angular/cli
ng version
```

## Done when
- [ ] `node -v` and `ng version` work in a new terminal

title: Create the Azure account
body:
Week 9 deploys Anjeer to Azure Container Apps. Open the account **this week, not earlier** — the free credit is time-limited.

```powershell
winget install -e --id Microsoft.AzureCLI
az login
az account show
```

## Done when
- [ ] `az account show` lists the subscription
- [ ] A budget alert is set in Cost Management (e.g. $10/month) so nothing runs up a bill unnoticed

title: Create an Azure OpenAI resource and deploy a test model
body:
Week 18 starts the AI phase. Do this two weeks early, so quota or access problems don't block week 18.

1. Azure portal → **Azure OpenAI** → Create (same resource group as Anjeer, a region that offers the chat and embedding models you need).
2. Deploy one chat model and one embedding model.
3. Send one test request from the portal playground.

If the subscription has no quota for these models (common on free-trial subscriptions), upgrade it to Pay-As-You-Go or request quota now.

## Done when
- [ ] A chat model and an embedding model are deployed
- [ ] The playground answers a test prompt
- [ ] The endpoint and deployment names are noted in `notes/azure.md` (no keys in Git)
